title: Yale and August Enhance User Experience
summary: Yale and August Enhance User Experience
body_markdown:
Guided by customer feedback, we’ve announced a series of updates to the Yale Access and August Home apps throughout 2026 designed to enhance the user experience, making the apps easier to use, more reliable, and more insightful.


One of the key enhancements is **Battery Insights** , which is now available on the Yale Assure Lock 2. This new feature provides smarter alerts and guidance to help users stay ahead of battery replacements. Battery Insights builds on the latest updates to the Yale Access app and August Home app, including a refreshed interface. Learn more about additional[recent and upcoming key enhancements](https://shopyalehome.com/blogs/news-room/yale-and-august-apps-get-smarter-new-features-put-more-control-and-convenience-at-your-fingertips) .


Through these continuous improvements, Yale and August reinforce their leadership in smart home security and commitment to integrating customer feedback, offering users smarter, simpler, and more dependable ways to protect, connect, and securely access their homes.
